_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
I Player {player_id} i ni Three-Player Tic Tac Toe-ah.
I symbol chu '{symbol}' a ni.
I in turn-in i symbol dah tur a ni 5x5 board-ah line 4 siam turin.
Line chu horizontal, vertical, emaw diagonal a ni thei.
I move thehluh format '[4]' hmangin cell 4 mark turin.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Move format dik lo. '[cell]' hmangin cell 0-{max_cell} a ni.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Invalid cell number: {cell}. 0 leh {max_cell} inkar a ni.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Player {player_id} chuan tih dik loh a ti
